answer: At the tundra jetty, every identity moors at one of ten copper berths, and the k-th berth costs 50 times k times k-plus-one in copper: berth one 100, berth two 300, berth three 600, so ten identities pay 22,000 and a hundred pay 17,170,000. Berths free one per day, so the hundredth fake waits ninety days and still pays the full 17,170,000 to moor.
